title: crypto2dev: HMAC and CMAC callbacks
description: Implement CryptoCb handlers for HMAC-SHA-256/384/512 and CMAC-AES. HMAC: acquire OPERATION fd, INIT('hmac(sha256)' etc.) with inline key, write() message data across one or more Update calls, FINALIZE, read() MAC, release fd. CMAC: same pattern with algo='cmac(aes)' and AES key. SETKEY path (WC_ALGO_TYPE_SETKEY for HMAC/CMAC): store key material in devCtx on the Hmac/Cmac struct. Free path (WC_ALGO_TYPE_FREE): release fd and free devCtx if operation was in progress.
notes: HMAC key fits inline in INIT (max 128 bytes for SHA-512, well within 128-byte INIT key limit). CMAC key is 16/24/32 bytes — also fits inline. Single fd per HMAC/CMAC object. Safety invariant from caliptra port applies: WC_HW_E \!= CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE (add static assert).
